sources.source_name: CSLB Public Data Portal — License Master
sources.regulator: Contractors State License Board (Department of Consumer Affairs)
sources.count_notes: Free file covers currently renewed OR expired-but-renewable licenses. Cancelled, revoked, and expired-non-renewable are omitted. Portal label: Updated as of 9/2/2026. This ticket's CSV postback transferred 27,890,218 bytes then dropped (IncompleteRead). Do not treat homepage snapshots as file row counts.

MAILING_BUSINESS_ADDRESS.note: portal describes address; mailing vs physical not split in the public description

sources.terms_notes: No charge. Disclaimer: current as of the date under the download link. Verify current status via Instant License Check. CA.gov Conditions of Use + DCA privacy policy.
sources.redistribution_notes: Do not commit the full master CSV. Do not treat missing cancelled/revoked rows as zero discipline.
sources.blocker: ASP.NET postback to ctl00$MainContent$lbMasterCSV started a file (>=27.8MB) then the HTTP body truncated. Not a CAPTCHA. Retry with streaming next ticket.
sources.recommended_next_action: Stream the official CSV/XLS postback to data/raw (gitignored). Profile phone occupancy. Commit header+3-row fixture only.

sources.identity_field: CSLB license number + currently associated personnel name/title
sources.grain: person currently associated with a license
sources.terms_notes: Disassociated personnel are not included in the free file.
sources.redistribution_notes: Personnel names are official license associations, not a consumer contact list. Do not infer personal phone/email.
sources.blocker: Master CSV transfer failed first; personnel download not attempted.
sources.recommended_next_action: Download after master succeeds. Join on license number only.

sources.source_name: CSLB Public Data Portal — Workers Compensation
sources.grain: workers compensation policy row for a license
sources.recommended_next_action: Download with master. Missing WC != uninsured without Instant Check.

sources.count_notes: Official page lists A, B, B-2, and 43 C-codes (C-2 through C-61 as published), plus ASB and HAZ certifications. C-61 Limited Specialty has additional D-subclasses not enumerated here.
sources.recommended_next_action: Use as taxonomy. Do not scrape every D-subclass page this ticket.

sources.terms_notes: Portal page matched a captcha token in HTML. Do not scrape. Current-status source of record for a single license.
sources.blocker: Interactive lookup. Possible CAPTCHA. Not a bulk API.
sources.recommended_next_action: Keep as consumer verify link. Do not automate.

sources.source_name: CSLB License Master Full File / Update File
sources.regulator: Contractors State License Board — Data Services Unit
sources.count_notes: Official forms page: FULL file provides 830,000+ records. Fee $235 non-refundable per file. Text file, not Excel. Personnel is a separate 1.3+ million Business Principle Full File. Emails are not included.
sources.recommended_next_action: Do not wait. Free master is the first universe. Draft is in docs/california/requests/cslb-full-file.md.

sources.regulator: Contractors State License Board — Data Services Unit
sources.count_notes: Fee $245. Currently renewed only. No expired/cancelled/revoked. No personnel. No email. Form Rev. 06/2026.
sources.recommended_next_action: Skip unless a filtered extract is needed after the free master lands.

sources.count_notes: WSDL live. Empty-token GetDataByClassification(C-10) returned HTTP 200 with errorMessage Missing Classification or Token. Not an open anonymous API.
sources.blocker: Token required. Do not claim OPEN_API.
sources.recommended_next_action: Prefer the free master CSV. Do not guess tokens.

sources.count_notes: Report totals are not a license roster. FY 2024/25: 19,257 complaints received; 591 licenses revoked; 455 licenses suspended (report figures). Complaint != violation. Accusation != finding.
sources.recommended_next_action: Publish as coverage evidence. Never auto-attach to a profile from this PDF.

sources.count_notes: Summer 2026 newsletter points consumers to cslb.ca.gov/RevokedLicenses. Disciplinary_Actions.aspx returned a Page Not Found title on 2026-09-03. Instant License Check remains the per-license disclosure path. Do not scrape.
sources.recommended_next_action: Confirm page shape next contractor ticket. Join only on license number.

sources.count_notes: No bulk CSV on data.ca.gov. Legacy Salesforce search cadir.my.salesforce-sites.com/ContractorSearch returned HTTP 503 this ticket. services.dir.ca.gov/pw returned HTTP 200 (LETF Dashboard / Public Works Portal HTML). Local debarment downloads may require captcha for public users. PWCR != CSLB license.
sources.blocker: No documented public bulk roster. Do not scrape. Do not captcha-bypass local debarment Excel.
sources.recommended_next_action: Keep as search capability. Do not wait on PRA.

sources.regulator: Labor Commissioner's Office (DLSE), Department of Industrial Relations
sources.count_notes: HTML table live (page dated July 2025 in footer). Parser saw 67 period strings and 62 table data rows. Two-digit years such as 4/1/44 are ambiguous, so currently-in-force count is UNKNOWN. Distinct from DIR local debarment list. Federal EPLS/SAM is a separate list.

PHYSICAL_BUSINESS_ADDRESS.note: some historical rows include an address

sources.recommended_next_action: Parse into a small reviewed fixture. Attach to profiles only on exact CSLB number. Preserve unmatched rows.

sources.recommended_next_action: Keep as person-level enrichment. Never auto-attach to a contractor profile from name+zip.

sources.regulator: Department of Industrial Relations — Electrician Certification Unit
sources.recommended_next_action: Do not use as a contractor business list.

sources.recommended_next_action: Optional enrichment after CSLB master. Never replace a license roster with vendor rows.

sources.source_name: DCA Open Data / Box licensee lists
sources.count_notes: DCA points CSLB users to https://cslb.ca.gov/onlineservices/dataportal/ rather than the Box dump. Box URL https://dca.box.com/s/oss6hf8jys2bmgxqd2gdz7w4oepm2il9 is advertised for other boards. Do not scrape Box.
sources.recommended_next_action: Use CSLB Data Portal for contractors. Recheck Box only for BHGS if a household-mover list appears.

sources.source_name: CDPH Licensed and Certified Healthcare Facility Locations (ELMS)
sources.regulator: California Department of Public Health — Center for Health Care Quality
sources.count_notes: Datastore total 15,097. FAC_STATUS_TYPE_CODE=OPEN for all 15,097 dumped rows. LICENSE_STATUS_DESCRIPTION: ACTIVE 13,401; blank 1,357; INACTIVE - CAPEN DECISION 339. DATA_DATE 2026-08-17. Facility types include Home Health Agency 4,137; Hospice 2,114; SNF 1,186. This is not RCFE.

BUSINESS_EMAIL.note: CONTACT_EMAIL may be an administrator mailbox. Do not treat as a personal consumer email harvest.

sources.recommended_next_action: Primary Senior state universe for CDPH-licensed facilities. Commit small fixtures only.

sources.source_name: HCAI Current California Healthcare Facility Listing
sources.regulator: Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI)
sources.count_notes: Datastore total 10,871. FACILITY_STATUS_DESC Open 10,856; Suspense 14; Closed 1. No phone/email fields. Categories include Home Health Agency 4,310; Hospice 2,669; SNF 1,078; GACH 458.
sources.recommended_next_action: Crosswalk to ELMS via licensed-facility-crosswalk. Do not invent phones from this file.

sources.count_notes: XLSX resources exist (ELMS-ASPEN-OSHPD, ELMS-ASPEN, ELMS-OSHPD). Last-modified metadata on the XLSX is 2024. Approved deterministic crosswalk when IDs match.
sources.recommended_next_action: Acquire XLSX next Senior ticket. Do not commit the full workbook.

sources.source_name: CDSS CCLD Residential Care Facilities for the Elderly
sources.regulator: California Department of Social Services — Community Care Licensing Division
sources.count_notes: Datastore resource 744d1583-f9eb-45b6-b0f8-b9a9dab936a6. file_date 05/25/2025. LICENSED 7,939; CLOSED 3,821; PENDING 739; ON PROBATION 23. Types: RESIDENTIAL CARE ELDERLY 12,389; RCFE-CONTINUING CARE RETIREMENT COMMUNITY 132. This snapshot is older than ELMS. Live search remains https://www.ccld.dss.ca.gov/carefacilitysearch/. Missing later months != zero facilities.

BUSINESS_PHONE.note: CKAN COUNT(column) is non-null, not non-blank. Sample phones are populated. Exact non-empty excluding 'Unavailable' is UNKNOWN without a dump profile.

sources.recommended_next_action: Dump CSV next Senior ticket. RCFE != SNF. CCRC rows are a subtype, not a separate regulator.

sources.regulator: California Department of Social Services — CCLD
sources.count_notes: Datastore total 3,654 as of file_date 05/25/2025. Home care organization != home health agency (CDPH).
sources.recommended_next_action: Keep distinct from CDPH home health.

sources.regulator: California Department of Social Services — CCLD
sources.count_notes: Not all rows are senior-specific. Do not collapse into RCFE.
sources.recommended_next_action: Filter by facility_type before any Senior profile use.

sources.regulator: California Department of Social Services — CCLD
sources.count_notes: Live search. Page advertises a Download Data feature. The CHHS ccl-facilities CSVs are the bulk path used here. Do not scrape the search UI.
sources.recommended_next_action: Consumer verify link. Use CHHS dumps for bulk.

sources.count_notes: Datastore total 5,435. Action mix includes Letter of Agreement 4,212; Settlement Agreement 606; Cease and Desist Order 240; Accusation 53. OrganizationName is not NAIC. Accusation != finding. This is Knox-Keene / DMHC, not CDI admitted P&C.
sources.recommended_next_action: Use as source-level evidence. Profile attach only with EXACT NAIC/plan ID crosswalk — none is in this file.

sources.source_name: DMHC Independent Medical Review Determinations, Trend
sources.count_notes: Datastore total 42,749. No plan NAIC in the dumped columns. PatientGender/AgeRange are aggregate attributes of the review, not a consumer PII dump we republish. Do not attach to a named issuer without an official plan identifier.
sources.recommended_next_action: Aggregate coverage only. 84MB dump stays gitignored.

sources.source_name: CDI Producer Licensing Bureau mailing lists
sources.count_notes: Paid lists. Agent/agency qualification lists priced from $75 minimum to greater than $4,000. Company appointment list $363 per NAIC. Check required. ~400,000 licensed agents/brokers is a Find-an-Agent marketing figure, not a verified extract count from this ticket.
sources.recommended_next_action: Low effort this ticket. Company-level CDI HTML list is the easy win.

sources.source_name: DFPI California Residential Mortgage Lending Act
sources.regulator: Department of Financial Protection and Innovation
sources.count_notes: No Florida-OFR-style free bulk mortgage roster on data.ca.gov. Official page sends the public to NMLS Consumer Access and DOCQNET. 2024 CRMLA Annual Report snapshot: 389 licensees and 5,104 branches as of December 31, 2024 — that is a report figure, not a live file row count.
sources.blocker: No free bulk CRMLA roster found. NMLS root returned Cloudflare 403 to this user-agent.
sources.recommended_next_action: Use NMLS Consumer Access as the public verify path. Do not scrape DOCQNET.

sources.regulator: Department of Financial Protection and Innovation
sources.count_notes: HTTP 200. Page states Individual MLO licenses should be checked through NMLS Consumer Access.
sources.recommended_next_action: Do not scrape.

sources.regulator: Nationwide Multistate Licensing System (state-license records; not a California regulator)
sources.count_notes: HTTP 403 Cloudflare from this user-agent. DFPI and CalDRE both point consumers here. State vs NMLS: NMLS is the system of record display for many CA mortgage licenses, not a California bulk download.
sources.recommended_next_action: Browser verify link only.

sources.identity_field: DRE license number; MLO endorsement is not a CRMLA license
sources.count_notes: HTTP 200. DRE MLO endorsement != DFPI CRMLA/CFL company license. No bulk roster found this ticket.
sources.recommended_next_action: Keep distinct from DFPI. Do not merge MLO endorsement into a mortgage-company universe.

sources.count_notes: Official HTML table of CalHFA-approved lender branches with street address and phone and program flags. Unique legal-entity count UNKNOWN (many repeated branch rows). CalHFA approval != DFPI license and != NMLS authorization.
sources.recommended_next_action: Parse branch table next Lender ticket. Do not rank 'top hero' officers as Trust Hub ranking.
